connectorUiConfig.title: Varonis SaaS (Serverless - CCF)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
**IMPORTANT: This is an experimental CCF connector that requires Varonis API modifications to function properly.**

Varonis SaaS provides the capability to ingest [Varonis Alerts](https://www.varonis.com/products/datalert) into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework.

**Known Limitations:**
- Requires Varonis API to support standard OAuth2 client_credentials flow
- Multi-step search API pattern not fully supported in CCF
- Async polling with retry logic (304/206 status codes) not natively supported
- Search ID parameter must be pre-configured

**Current Implementation:**
This connector uses a simplified approach that assumes a pre-configured search. For full functionality, Varonis API modifications are required.

Varonis prioritizes deep data visibility, classification capabilities, and automated remediation for data access. Varonis builds a single prioritized view of risk for your data, so you can proactively and systematically eliminate risk from insider threats and cyberattacks.

sampleQueries.query:
VaronisAlerts_CL
| where AlertSeverity == "High"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

VaronisAlerts_CL
| where ContainsMaliciousExternalIPs == true
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

VaronisAlerts_CL
| summarize count() by ThreatDetectionPolicyName
| sort by count_ desc

dataTypes.name: VaronisAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
VaronisAlerts_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Important Notice
instructionSteps.description:
⚠️ **This is an experimental connector** that demonstrates the intended CCF implementation for Varonis SaaS. It requires Varonis API modifications to function properly.

**Required Varonis API Changes:**
1. Support for standard OAuth2 client_credentials flow
2. Direct alert retrieval endpoint (bypassing multi-step search)
3. Standard bearer token authentication for all API calls

Please contact Varonis support to request these API enhancements.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1: Obtain Varonis API Credentials
instructionSteps.description:
To generate the API key:
1. Launch the Varonis Web Interface
2. Navigate to **Configuration → API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key**
4. Fill in the name and description
5. Click **Generate Key**
6. Copy the API key secret and save it securely

[See Varonis Documentation](https://help.varonis.com/s/document-item?bundleId=ami1661784208197&topicId=emp1703144742927.html&_LANG=enus)
